mediaKit.title: @nicobehm/media-kit
mediaKit.description: Media components from the own package: CompareSlider (drag/hover, color/B&W) and MediaLightbox with zoom.
mediaKit.hoverCaption: mode="hover" — follows the pointer without clicking
mediaKit.portraitCompareLabel: Compare black and white with color
mediaKit.portraitCaption: Simulated colorization — a single bitmap; the B&W side is derived with filter: grayscale(1). AI-generated portrait.
mediaKit.modesDescription: The same compareMode prop behind the two demos above adds three more comparison axes: onion skin, blink and side-by-side.
mediaKit.modesBeforeAlt: Desaturated version of the landscape photo
mediaKit.modesCaption: compareMode="wipe" | "onion" | "blink" | "side-by-side" — same landscape photo, four ways to compare it.
mediaKit.spotlightDescription: A lens that reveals color under the pointer — same trick as the comparisons above: one bitmap, one CSS filter for the black & white side.
mediaKit.spotlightBaseAlt: Black and white version of the landscape photo
mediaKit.spotlightCaption: SpotlightReveal — move the pointer (or use the arrow keys) to reveal color under the lens.
mediaKit.filterGalleryDescription: FilterGallery groups items into categories and repositions them with a manual FLIP animation (WAAPI) when the filter changes, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
mediaKit.filterGalleryCaption: FilterGallery — filter by category to see the FLIP reflow animation.
mediaKit.scrubDescription: Move the pointer over the video (or focus it and use the arrow keys) to scrub through the clip, like YouTube thumbnail previews.
mediaKit.scrubLabel: Scrub preview of a short clip
mediaKit.scrubHint: Move the pointer to scrub the video
mediaKit.scrubCaption: VideoScrubPreview — move the pointer, or focus it and press the arrow keys, Home or End.
